content: संन्यासः .²1 Leaving, abandonment. .²2 Complete renunciation of the world and its possessions and attachments, abandonment of temporal concerns; काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः <ls>Bg. 18. 2</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 114</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 108</ls>. .²3 A deposit, trust; एतद्राज्यं मम भ्रात्रा दत्तं संन्यासमुत्तमम् <ls>Rām. 2. 115. 14</ls>. .²4 A stake or wager in a game. .²5 Giving up the body, death. .²6 Indian spikenard. .²7 Compact, agreement.
